avalanche.body: Sjekk dagens skredvarsel for Lofoten og Vesterålen på varsom.no. Ta med sender/mottaker, søkestang og spade.

no.caption: 988 høydemeter fra fjæra på Haukland på 3,89 km; det bratteste ligger mellom 500 og 600 moh.

en.intro: Vestvågøy's highest mountain, starting on the shore at Haukland and climbing 988 m in just under four kilometres. A short tour, but the last third is steep and the summit ridge is narrow.
ascent: From the car park at Hauklandstranda, six metres above the sea, head north toward the southern portal of the tunnel to Utakleiv. Not through the tunnel: take the service road that climbs north-east over it, past Klumpan, and follow it until it levels out on the bench at 150 m at the mouth of Durmålsdalen. The marked path starts here, and it runs all the way up to the cairn at 931. The car park charges year round, by machine or app; it is priced by the hour and time-limited to keep the beach turning over, so pay for the whole tour before you set off.

Continue north-east up the south side of Durmålsdalen. The ground is open the whole way — there is no forest on this tour — and the line settles into long zig-zags up toward the shoulder at Molheia. It steepens from 300 m: the bands from 300 to 700 m run at a mean of 21.7 to 23.2 degrees, and the steepest step on the line measures 28.4 degrees, between 666 and 687 m. Do not cut straight up the west flank of the summit ridge; it runs at 34 to 37 degrees on average with sections to 46. You take the height on the shoulder on the south side.

From Molheia at around 800 m it is only thirty metres up to the 830 m sub-peak and the small flat there. That is the last wide ground on the tour — south-east of the flat the terrain falls at 38 degrees on average. From here on you are on the ridge.

From the flat the ridge runs north, and it is narrow. Follow the crest to the cairn at 931. Do not step out onto the east side — large cornices hang there over very steep ground: below the cairn the east flank measures 42 degrees on average, the south-east flank 44, with sections of 54 to 57. Further north the ridge drops to 898 m and then rises to the main top, which measures 956 m in the terrain model. A military radar installation stands on the ridge at 936 m, a hundred metres or so below the top; the ground around it is closed, so follow the crest past it and obey the signs on site.
descent: Back along the ridge to the sub-peak, on the crest or just west of it. From there you have close to seven hundred unbroken metres down the wide Durmålsdalen to the bench at 150 m. For a variation, turn right into Øvredalen just before the sub-peak and follow the flank between the valleys until it eases at around 600 m, then back left into Durmålsdalen.

The common mistake: following Durmålsdalen all the way down. That puts you out on the Utakleiv side with the tunnel between you and the car. Keep right where the valley flattens at around 150 m and take the service road over the tunnel back to Haukland.

The lee slopes to the east and south are steep and sit directly under the cornices on the summit ridge. They fall eight hundred metres to the access road on the south and east sides of the mountain, which runs between 75 and 180 m — not into Durmålsdalen. Choose them deliberately, not because you came off the ridge on the wrong side.

avalanche.title: The route
avalanche.body: The lower half is gentle and open. It steepens from 300 m: the bands from 300 to 800 m hold 19.4 to 23.2 degrees on average, steepest between 500 and 600 m. The steepest step on the line measures 28.4 degrees, between 666 and 687 m. From the sub-peak north the ridge is narrow, with a drop to 898 m and fifty metres of re-climb before the main top.

avalanche.title: The terrain around it
avalanche.body: The east side of the summit ridge carries large, permanent cornices over very steep ground. Measured from the cairn, the east flank falls at 42 degrees on average and the south-east flank at 44, with individual sections of 54 to 57. Stay on the crest or just west of it the whole way from the sub-peak north. The west flank above Durmålsdalen runs at 34 to 37 degrees on average with sections to 46, and is not to be cut directly, going up or coming down.

avalanche.title: Before you go
avalanche.body: Check the day's avalanche forecast for Lofoten og Vesterålen at varsom.no. Bring a transceiver, probe and shovel.

en.caption: 988 m of climbing from the shore at Haukland over 3.89 km; the steep ground sits between 500 and 600 m.

sources: Kartverket DTM1 / SSR waypoint data and OSM way references supplied in the route brief and audit notes
himmeltindan.uncertain: The 962 m point is described as closed for a military radar installation, which friflyt corroborates; I did not state a skiable summit elevation in the prose because the tour record (962), the terrain model (948.7) and the cairn skiers actually use (931) are three different points. Friflyt's own start is Grendehuset på Uttakleiv rather than Hauklandstranda — the two car parks are 900 m apart at the same height and the paths merge, so I described only the Hauklandstranda approach and did not present the other as a separate route. The tour record lists aspect Ø, but the ascent and all the skiing described here are in Durmålsdalen on the west/south-west side; I named places rather than a compass aspect to avoid contradicting the field. I did not name Fehammaren, since only Klumpan, Durmålsdalen and Molheia were confirmed against SSR.
problems: VERTICAL OVERSTATED, AND IT CONTRADICTED THE NEXT PARAGRAPH. descent[0]: '800 sammenhengende høydemeter ned den brede Durmålsdalen'. That is friflyt's figure, and friflyt measures it from the 830 m sub-peak all the way down Durmålsdalen to Utakleiv, which is their start. This guide starts at Haukland, and its own next paragraph tells you to leave the valley at the 150 m bench and cross over the tunnel. Fortopp (Kartverket DTM 827.2) to bench (DTM 158.0) is 669 m. Corrected to 'snaut sju hundre' and the bench named as the bottom of the run, which also removes the self-contradiction.

Ridge saddle re-climb wrong. 'Faller til rundt 898 moh ... tretti meter ned og opp igjen'. The saddle is confirmed at 898.2 m (Kartverket punkt, 68.2188/13.5720), so it is 33 m down from the 931 cairn — but 50 m back up to the main top at 948.7 m, not 30. Corrected in both the ascent paragraph and the avalanche box.

Steep-band figures attached to the wrong paragraph. ascent[2] said 'Fra Molheia rundt 800 moh fortsetter du opp til fortoppen på 830 ... Dette er den bratteste delen av turen: hundremeteren mellom 700 og 800 moh'. The 700–800 m band lies below Molheia, on the approach described in the previous paragraph, not on the 797→827 m step from Molheia to the fortopp, which is nearly flat. Moved the numbers to the ground they describe and gave the fortopp paragraph a measured fact of its own (south-east of the flat the ground falls 37.7° on average, steepest 60 m window 49.4°).

PLACE-NAME SPELLING. 'Uttakleivtunnelen' and 'Uttakleiv-sida'. SSR has no entry for 'Uttakleiv'; the register spelling is Utakleiv (Gard, Vestvågøy, 68.21257/13.52047), and friflyt writes Utakleiv too. OSM tags the road tunnel name=Uttakleivtunnelen but tunnel:name=Utakleiv. Rather than mix two spellings in one guide, the tunnel is now described rather than named ('tunnelen til Utakleiv') and the place is spelled per SSR.

FLANK CLAIMS MEASURED — all three hold, and now carry the numbers. (1) 'Store hengskavler over svært bratt lende' on the east side: verbatim in friflyt ('Store hengskavler langs østsiden av toppryggen, ned mot svært bratt lende') and measured from the 931 cairn as east 41.6° mean / 54.0° steepest 60 m window, south-east 44.3°/57.4°, south 40.6°/56.0°. (2) 'Vestflanken ... 35 grader og mer': measured west from the cairn 34.4° mean over 600 m with 37–47° steps between 80 and 220 m out, and 37.0° mean / 46.0° steepest from the mid-ridge point 68.2174/13.5702. Restated as 34–37° mean with sections to 46. (3) 'Lehengene ... ender ved anleggsveien til radaren': sourced (friflyt says the east and south alternatives end near the military access road) and confirmed in OSM — service way 173448255, motor_vehicle=private, emergency_access, runs the south side at Kartverket 74–143 m, and track 609615253 climbs the east side to 181 m. Measured runout: south from the cairn 928→130 m over 1.2 km, south-east 928→100 m. Added the ~800 m of drop and the road's height.

Radar geography made explicit. OSM node 2939565002, military=radar, sits at 68.21982/13.57303, Kartverket DTM 935.6 m — 220 m NNE of the 931 cairn and 65 m short of the main top the routed line reaches. The prose sent you to 'hovedtoppen' and then said the highest point is closed, without saying they are the same ground. Reworded so the crest, the 898 m saddle, the main top and the closed 962 m point read as one continuous piece of terrain.

Marked path claim now confirmed, and strengthened. The audit could not verify OSM way 290430750 because Overpass was down. It resolves cleanly: highway=path, sac_scale=mountain_hiking, trail_visibility=good, 445 nodes, from 68.20574/13.53854 at the 158 m bench to 68.21779/13.57183 at the 931 cairn — summit-specific and monotonic, exactly as the research notes claimed. The ascent now says the marked path runs all the way to the cairn.

VERIFIED, LEFT ALONE: 6 m start, 965 m gain, 3.39 km, no forest on the tour, 150 m bench (158.0), Molheia at ~800 m (SSR Ås 68.21498/13.56674, DTM 796.8), fortoppen på 830 (827.2), varden på 931 (928.5), 700–800 m band at 28.6°, steepest step 36.1°, Klumpan (SSR Haug 68.20684/13.53706), Durmålsdalen (SSR Dal 68.21186/13.55328), the Øvredalen variant (SSR Dal, Vestvågøy, 68.21838/13.54682, DTM 365 m — the valley 720 m north of Durmålsdalen, so 'til høyre' is correct when descending west, and friflyt describes exactly this branch rejoining Durmålsdalen at 600 m), Lofoten og Vesterålen as the Varsom region, literal 'varsom.no' in both languages, NO/EN 4/3/3 paragraph parity.

SOURCES USED: friflyt.no/topptur/skiturer-lofoten/turbeskrivelse-himmeltind (Durmålsdalen, Molheia, fortoppen 830, the narrow ridge to the 931 cairn, the radar closure, the 800 m Durmålsdalen descent, the Øvredalen branch, the east/south alternatives ending at the military access road, and the cornice sentence verbatim); visitlofoten.com/en/four-great-summit-tours-during-winter/; SSR for Himmeltindan 68.21779/13.57186, Durmålsdalen, Molheia, Klumpan, Øvredalen, Fehammaren, Utakleiv; OSM ways 290430750, 173448255, 609615253 and node 2939565002; Kartverket DTM1 point queries and radial flank profiles as above.

STILL UNCERTAIN: friflyt gives the closed high point as 964 moh, the tour record as 962; the prose keeps 962 to stay consistent with the record. No skiable summit elevation is stated, because the record (962), the terrain model (948.7) and the cairn skiers actually use (931) are three different points — and SSR in fact places the name Himmeltindan at the 931 cairn (68.21779/13.57186), not at the main top. Friflyt's own start is Grendehuset på Utakleiv; the two car parks are 900 m apart at the same height and the paths merge, so only the Hauklandstranda approach is described. The record lists aspect Ø, but the ascent and all the skiing described are on the west/south-west side in Durmålsdalen, so places are named instead of a compass aspect.

no.intro: Lofot-klassikeren i overkommelig format: 685 høydemeter fra veikanten til en varde som står rett på stupkanten. Kort nok til en ettermiddag, stor nok til å bli en favoritt.
ascent: Fra parkeringen ved skianlegget i Nappskaret, en kilometer vest for Napp, går du nordover og holder deg til venstre for skitrekket. Rett over øvre trekkstolpe, ved 139 moh, samles stiene fra de ulike parkeringene til ett spor — starter du fra den vestre parkeringen drøyt 250 meter unna, kommer du inn på det samme sporet her. Fra 61 moh og opp er du over skoggrensa hele veien; det finnes ikke skog på denne ruta.

Sporet svinger nordøst inn i dalen mellom Okstinden og Litlnappstinden og krysser Myrlandselva rundt 215 moh. Videre opp dalen til søkket ved Skarvatnet, det islagte tjernet på 341 moh. Hold til venstre opp mot Middagstinden, og legg deg deretter mot høyre der terrenget heller slakest — det er den linja som tar deg opp uten å komme borti sørflanken.

Over 500 moh reiser terrenget seg til et kort, bratt trinn opp på ryggen ved 560 moh. Hundremeterssjiktene ligger tett på hverandre: det bratteste, 600 til 700 moh, holder 17,1° i snitt, og nede i dalen mellom 200 og 300 moh er det 16,7°. Bratteste enkelttrinn på hele linja måler 25,1°, og det ligger nettopp her — mellom 498 og 530 moh. Over trinnet flater det ut, og fra rundt 724 moh går den brede toppflata østover som en 13 graders rampe inn mot varden.

Varden på 741 moh står på kanten av østveggen. Stopp ved varden. Toppen bærer store hengskavler mot øst, og øst- og nordøstsida over Napp og Perklubben faller 42–43° i snitt med bergband over 60° — det er stup, ikke en linje.
descent: Ned samme vei. Dalen mellom Okstinden og Litlnappstinden gir variert kjøring, og fra søkket ved Skarvatnet er det åpent hele veien ned til trekket.

Vanligste feil: å slippe seg sørover fra toppflata fordi det ser kortere ut. Sørsida rett under toppen faller nær 39° i snitt, med partier over 50°, og det er der skredene går på dette fjellet. Hold vestover i stedet — vest er den slakeste sida av fjellet, 22° i snitt — og følg oppstigninga tilbake til søkket.
Femti meter fra varden tar du til venstre, rett sør, inn i renna: 40° og 400 meter lang, og den munner ut i et bredere parti rett over Litlnappstinden. Det er en egen avgjørelse, ikke en snarvei.

avalanche.title: Ruta
avalanche.body: Oppstigninga gjennom dalen er slak: ingen hundremeterssjikt på ruta holder mer enn 17,1°, og det bratteste er 600–700 moh. Men snittet skjuler trinnet opp på ryggen: bratteste enkelttrinn på linja måler 25,1° mellom 498 og 530 moh, kort og bratt. Det er de partiene som kan løsne på normalruta.

avalanche.title: Terrenget rundt
avalanche.body: Toppen bærer store hengskavler mot øst, og øst- og nordøstsida over Napp og Perklubben faller 42–43° i snitt med bergband over 60°. Sørflanken rett under toppen holder nær 39°, og renna sør for varden 40° over 400 meter. Vestover er fjellet slakest, 22° i snitt. Går du utenom normalruta, er det disse du velger mellom.
